about.title: About
about.subtitle: Armelle Boussidan
about.description: Facilitator, consultant and artist based in France. Multilingual practice across art, ecological transition, and well-being.
about.artistConsultant: Consultant, Facilitator & Artist · FR · EN · ES
about.defaultBio: I am a consultant and artist, with a keen interest in both innovation and ancestral knowledge.
about.m33Desc: M33 is a collective artist studio in Strasbourg that I co-founded in 2014.
about.lostRoomDesc: The Lost Room was a collective based in Villeurbanne (2011–2012).
about.pathDesc: A path woven between intuition and science, innovation and ancestral knowledge, from a PhD in cognitive science and linguistics to over a decade of painting and collective art practice. Along the way, training in permaculture and contemplative practices deepened a holistic understanding of how people and systems work. Freelance consulting since 2018, translation, facilitation, and coordination across cultural, ecological, and well-being sectors.

consulting.title: Consulting
consulting.subtitle: Professional Services
consulting.description: Freelance consultant since 2018, translation, interpreting, writing, and project coordination in English and French.
consulting.intro: With a PhD in cognitive science, I bring a distinctive perspective to multilingual project coordination, one shaped by scientific rigour, creative sensitivity, and a deep understanding of how people think, communicate, and collaborate across cultures. I work at the intersection of ecological transition, the arts, well-being, and community development, with a particular sensitivity to neurodiversity.
consulting.vision: I combine linguistic precision with cross-cultural sensitivity and an attention to the human dimension of every project, ensuring that things move forward clearly, inclusively, and with depth. I believe the most impactful collaborations honour both efficiency and meaning. If you have a meaningful project in mind, I'd love to hear about it.
consulting.consultantDesc: Project coordination and facilitation across ecological and social transition, the arts, and well-being, with a holistic approach attentive to group dynamics and individual sensitivities.
consulting.interpreterDesc: Two-way online consecutive interpretation in English and French, translation and editing/proofreading. Bridging and connecting people, languages and cultures.
consulting.writerDesc: Content writing, blog writing, and editing in English and French.
consulting.m33Desc: Co-founded and managed a collective artist studio in Strasbourg, from vision to daily operations, budgeting, and programming.
consulting.sunseedDesc: Led operations and community governance as Facilitation Coordinator of a 30-year-old eco-village in Andalusia, Spain, hands-on ecological transition, sustainability, regenerative practices, and informal education.
consulting.existenceDesc: Customer service setup and management for a wellness centre in Ardèche, France. Payment processing, press articles, and newsletters.
consulting.orinkoDesc: Companies dedicated to ecological and social transition initiatives.
consulting.seed2shirtDesc: Directed regenerative systems implementation and facilitated multilingual communication for the Farmer Enrichment Program.
consulting.lifeItselfRole: Life & Studio Steward — Steward of Flow
consulting.lifeItselfDesc: Facilitating the daily life and operations of a collective at the crossroads of research, collective practice, and cultural activism, including the production of the Mythos magazine.
consulting.siaDesc: Co-building a research-backed app for Highly Sensitive People, product development, community strategy, and neurodiverse resource curation.
consulting.phdPlace: University of Lyon · CNRS · Institut des Sciences Cognitives · L2C2
consulting.phdDetail: Awarded highest distinction. "Creativity and Innovation — Cible" scholarship, Rhône-Alpes region.
